description: This Java source file, org.openmrs.logging.OpenmrsLoggingUtil, provides utility methods for managing and configuring logging within the OpenMRS platform. It includes functions for retrieving log appenders, obtaining log file locations, applying log levels dynamically, and reloading logging configurations.

classes.name: OpenmrsLoggingUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for managing Log4J logging configurations, retrieving log appender instances, and accessing log file locations within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: getMemoryAppender
methods.description: Retrieves the in-memory log appender used within the Log4J2 configuration; starts the appender if it is not already active.

methods.name: getOpenmrsLogLocation
methods.description: Returns the absolute file path of the OpenMRS log file if the configured appender matches known file-based appenders; returns null otherwise.

methods.name: applyLogLevels
methods.description: Sets log levels for classes based on the global property 'log.level.openmrs', supports multiple class and level configurations separated by commas.

methods.name: applyLogLevel
methods.description: Applies a specific log level to a designated logging class at runtime.

methods.name: applyLogLevelInternal
methods.description: Internal method that sets the log level for a specific class in the Log4J2 configuration based on input parameters.

methods.name: reloadLoggingConfiguration
methods.description: Reconfigures the Log4J2 logging system to apply any changes made to the configuration.
